notices.title: SPECIAL RAMADAN OPERATING SCHEDULE AND GRAND IFTAR PLATTER
notices.summary: Crown Coffee will observe updated operating hours from 3:00 PM until 1:00 AM daily throughout the holy month of Ramadan. Experience our curated artisanal coffee pairings and freshly prepared gourmet savory platters.
notices.content:
ATTENTION ALL VALUED GUESTS AND COFFEE ENTHUSIASTS,

In observance of the holy month of Ramadan, Crown Coffee Bangladesh is operating under updated daily schedules:

DAILY OPERATING HOURS: 3:00 PM - 1:00 AM

FEATURED HIGHLIGHT: THE SIGNATURE CROWN IFTAR PLATTER
Pairing freshly roasted single-origin espresso extractions with gourmet Medjool dates, house-crafted butter croissants, and savory artisan delights.

Advance table reservations and group bookings are now open.

notices.title: EXCLUSIVELY ARRIVED: ETHIOPIAN YIRGACHEFFE GRADE 1 MICRO-LOT
notices.summary: Discover extraordinary floral jasmine notes, bergamot citrus elegance, and wild honey sweetness in our newest artisanal micro-lot roast.
notices.content:
ANNOUNCING OUR LATEST SPECIALTY RELEASE:

Directly sourced from high-altitude volcanic soils in Yirgacheffe, Ethiopia. Roasted in-house in small batches to preserve delicate aromatics and vibrant fruity acidity.

RECOMMENDED BREWING METHOD:
V60 Pour-Over, Chemex extraction, or double shot specialty espresso.

Whole bean retail bags available at our front counter.

notices.title: WEEKEND BARISTA MASTERCLASS AND LATTE ART WORKSHOP
notices.summary: Master espresso extraction science, milk micro-foaming, and latte art mechanics with our head baristas in an exclusive hands-on session.
notices.content:
CROWN COFFEE SPECIAL ACADEMY WORKSHOP:

Join our senior baristas for an immersive weekend masterclass.

WHAT YOU WILL MASTER:
- Dialing in grind size and pressure parameters
- Texturing glossy micro-foam for latte art pouring
- Professional cupping and bean scoring methods

SEATS: Strictly limited to 8 attendees per session.
